entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the proceedings of Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari), under sections 272, 273, IPC and section 7/11 Food Adulteration Act, pending in the court of Ist A.C.J.M. Varanasi.

entities.text: Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that two proceedings lodged against the applicant for the same allegations.

The FIR was lodged against the applicant in Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs.
Ravindra Tiwari), under sections 272, 273, IPC and section 7/11 Food Adulteration Act, and also Complaint Case No.1521 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwariand others), under section 7/16 Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text:
Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs.
Ravindra Tiwari)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Complaint Case No.1521 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwariand others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He next submits that the Complaint Case No.1521 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Ravindra Tiwari vs State Of U.P. And Anr. on 4 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61848637/
1 Tiwariand others), under section 7/16 Food Adulteration Act, was decided by the trial court vide order dated 08.02.2013 and acquitted the applicant under section 7/16 Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Complaint Case No.1521 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Ravindra Tiwari vs State Of U.P. And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Now the proceeding of Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari), under sections 272, 273, IPC and section 7/11 Food Adulteration Act, is pending.

entities.text: Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant placed reliance of the judgment of Hon'ble Apex Court passed in the case of "Harish Vs. State of U.P. and others", in which the Hon'ble Apex Court has held that "refusal of quashing the prosecution under impugned order passed by the High Court is challenged on the same facts a prosecution under section 7/16 of the PFA Act was launched against the appellant and the said proceedings have ended in acquittal on the finding that the food item was not kept for sale, the Supreme Court held that in view of the finding recorded in the proceeding under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, the prosecution under IPC is bound to be a lame/sham prosecution".

entities.text: Harish Vs. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considered the submissions raised by counsel for the applicant and perused the entire record, it is clear that trial court has acquitted the applicant for the same incident alleged in the complaint.

Trial court has held proceeding adopted by investigation team was faulty and proceeding adopted under section 13(2) Food Adulteration Act is not in accordance with law and reliance cannot be placed upon report.

5. In view of the above, the proceeding of Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari), under sections 272, 273, IPC and section 7/11 Food Adulteration Act, pending in the court of Ist A.C.J.M.
Varanasi, is hereby quashed.

entities.text: Case No.106 of 2010 (State Vs. Ravindra Tiwari)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. The present 482 application is hereby allowed with the aforesaid observation.
